title: My lunch box
instructions: Ben okul için beslenme çantasını anlatıyor. Kısa bir metin; yiyeceklere dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Every day, I take a lunch box to school.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Today I have a cheese sandwich and an apple.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I also have a bottle of water.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I don't have chocolate. Mum says no!

questions.prompt: Where does Ben take his lunch box?
questions.evidence: I take a lunch box to school.

questions.prompt: What sandwich does Ben have today?
questions.evidence: Today I have a cheese sandwich
